intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-291#select-story-completed-in-ad-hoc-session

**Outcome: Caught.**

- **Story and revision.** SEED-291#select-story-completed-in-ad-hoc-session (`.planning/seeds/SEED-291-select-story-completed-in-ad-hoc-session.md#select-story-completed-in-ad-hoc-session`; plan `.planning/slice-plans/568-select-story-completed-in-ad-hoc-session/PLAN.md`) at product tip `786bd1254191070e0c4ce65a3438994429f580df`.
- **Promise.** When evidence cannot identify a unique completed story (dual independently matching Done candidates), association is `absent` — no false attribution.
- **Fault.** `dashboard/server/completedStoryAssociation.ts` uniqueness gate: `matched.length === 1` became `matched.length >= 1`.
- **Existing protection.** `dashboard/backend-tests/sessions/completed-story-association-ambiguous.spec.ts` asserts `associationOf(...)` equals `{ kind: "absent" }`.
- **Observed path.** Baseline passed; with fault, same assertion failed expecting absent and receiving linked SEED-B#b; after restore, same command passed. Scratch worktree removed; execution checkout unchanged.
- **Costs.** Test runtime ~11.8 s measured across three runs. Human effort unavailable. Agent effort unavailable. Invocation-to-report elapsed ~134960 ms.
